correctness.rationale: Exact equilibrium-age density from finite-mean Pareto renewal; SSEP one-point heat kernel; two-particle generator yields a negative adjacent-site source. The reflected-gap kernel gives a uniform O(log t/sqrt t) control on conditional connected correlations. Diffusive CLT, dominated convergence and strict monotonicity then prove the exact kernel and signs, while conditional negative covariances imply the block L2 law. The standard-library checker passed 70 finite/numerical assertions; these are corroboration, not a replacement for the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The published 2022 stationary renewal mixture establishes the age law and one-point density, not the equal-time two-point limit. The 2020 paper examines finite-ring dichotomous Poisson reset spatial correlations, not Pareto single-step resetting or its signed diffusive-scale limit. A common-age mechanism is known for independent Brownian gases, but does not prove interacting SSEP conditional anticorrelation decay or the strict cross-front sign classification. Targeted mathematical-result searches and primary-source comparisons found no theorem implying this exact statement; residual equivalence risk is retained.
residual_risks: A general hydrodynamic result for interacting exclusion systems under renewal resets might imply the same kernel without matching terminology; targeted searches found none but cannot certify uniqueness.

value.rationale: The primary 2022 model paper computes stationary density and current but does not resolve equal-time density fluctuations. This result exactly determines the macroscopic covariance and shows a strict same-side sign reversal relative to exclusion-only anticorrelations, an explicit non-self-averaging random hydrodynamic profile, and a cross-front negative sign. The diffusive window scale is physically dictated; these are structural, motivated effects rather than arbitrary substitutions or mere numerical recomputations.
